text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean of forecast minus observed power, in points of the substation's capacity; negative means the median forecast is too low. N1 is an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member from April 2024, with lagged power measured from the forecast origin. S1 is an XGBoost model trained on ERA5 weather from September 2023, without lagged power. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: mean over all cases of the lead band. Solid rule: no bias.'
text.tspan: Mean of forecast minus observed power, in points of the substation's capacity; negative
means the median forecast is too low.
N1 is an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member from April 2024, with
lagged power measured from the forecast origin. S1 is an XGBoost model trained on ERA5
weather from September 2023, without lagged power.
16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026.
Dot: mean over all cases of the lead band. Solid rule: no bias.
